lines.t: You poured your life like evening rain upon my desert soul
No shifting shade, no changing mask to make your love look whole
You did not bend to fit my mold, you stood and moved the same
Yet in that fire of constancy, you called me by my name
You didn't leave for me, ascended past the veil of starlit seas
But left your breath within my chest to whisper through the trees
Now every beat inside my heart echoes where you have been
A heaven-tethered melody that pulls me out of sin
It is hard to understand how to love with hands
So hard to hold the world and still make room
For broken ones like me inside
Yeah, I wish you a name like morning breaking over midnight sand
You write rivers in this weary one-day land
When every road of love I try turns quickly into dust
You walk with me through amber fields and teach my feet to trust
In every tear, in every scar, in all I try to be
You help me understand
You were the weight of all my nights, a crown, a thorn, and shame
You turned the cross into a door and whispered out my name
You loved through lies, through nails, through hate, through silence, deep and long
And turned the darkest hour into a resurrection song
Now in the mirror of your grace, I see a different face
Not caught by fear or failure, but shaped by time and grace
You're planting gardens in my scars, where once was only stone
And teaching me to love the loss the way you loved your own
It is hard to understand
How to bleed and still forgive
Too late, I'm pride to lose my all
And in that losing, truly live
You are dawn that splits the sky in golden trembling bands
You turn deserts into fields of singing startled lands
When I don't know how to love you, love through me again
A living echo of your heart until the world says amen
In every loss, in every gain, in all I try to be
You help me understand
Let my hands become the bread that feeds the hungry night
Let my words be oil and wine for wounds no one can cite
Let my life be land and light along a storm-tossed shore
Pointing every wandering heart to the one who loves them more
Teach me how to kneel and rise to lose and still abound
To scatter love like seed on rocks and still expect a crown
For in the school of Calvary where grace and sorrow stand
You take my trembling, broken heart and help me understand
Yeah, I wish you a name like fire wrapped in mercy's gentle hand
You turn ashes into anthems across this fractured land
When I don't know how to love you, love threw me a pin
But I live in echo of your heart until the world says amen
And in every tear, in every song, in all I hope to be
You help me understand
